name: Who manages the plumbing and electrical work during a bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: Who manages the plumbing and electrical work during a bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: You do not have to manage multiple contractors yourself. As a hands-on general contractor, Abraham Becerra coordinates every aspect of your bathroom upgrade. His crew directly handles custom framing, drywall repair, tile installation, trim carpentry, and painting, while bringing in trusted sub-trades for licensed plumbing and electrical tasks. You have a single point of contact on-site who oversees quality control, manages the daily schedule, and answers your questions throughout the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: HH Remodeling oversees the entire remodel, coordinating trusted plumbing and electrical trades while our crew handles framing, tile, drywall, and paint.
